text:
Alex Kim: quick heads-up — int4 bringup for model qbringup-3 is showing a rerank quality drop vs int8 baseline on our prompt-sampling batch. seeing +8% top-1 error on the rerank metric. sample batch attached in replies.
Priya Sharma: can you paste the diff in eval config and the sampling SQL? also which prompt cohort (assist/chat/code)?
Alex Kim: cohort=multi-turn-helpdesk (longer context). eval cmd i ran: `./eval_runner --model=qbringup-3 --quant=int4 --batch=5000 --metrics=rerank,emd,bleu`
Marco Diaz: sample SQL we used to pull prompts:
```sql
select id, prompt, context from prompt_bank where source in ('prod-logs','synthetic-mix') and tokens < 1024 order by rand() limit 5000;
```
Marco Diaz: FYI I noticed ~12% overlap with recent prod logs (same user queries) — could be contamination causing apparent regression.
Priya Sharma: good catch. we should de-dup against prod-logs and the golden set before labeling. can someone run a fingerprint diff (sha1) and report overlap count?
Alex Kim: running fingerprint diff now — will post counts in ~10m.
ops-bot: labeler-svc capacity check: current queue depth 1200, available annotators 7 (est throughput 180/hr). ETA to clear 2k relabel = ~11-12 hours.
Jen O'Neill: I can shift two annotators from microgold this afternoon to help, reduces ETA to ~8 hours. @ops-bot can you bump priority? :thumbsup:
ops-bot: bumped queue priority for thread 1736001123. will provision 2 extra annotators for 6 hours window.
Priya Sharma: proposal: pause qbringup-3 rollout, run de-duped 2k sample relabel (double-blind), re-eval rerank + human A/B. if regression persists we rollback and bisect quant kernels. agreement?
Marco Diaz: +1 on freeze. I'll also check kv-cache alignment differences between int4 and int8 at runtime — small cache mismatch sometimes skews rerank.
Alex Kim: agreed. starting relabel job and will attach overlap counts when done. attaching quick overlap snapshot: prod-log overlap 612/5000 (~12.2%), golden-set overlap 38/5000 (~0.8%).
Jen O'Neill: noted. I'll create a short label rubric for rerank edgecases and post in this thread for labelers.
Priya Sharma: thanks. once relabel completes, schedule a 30m sync to review human A/B and decide rollback. ping me when labels are in.
Alex Kim: will do. cc @Marco Diaz for kernel bisect tasks. :mag:
Marco Diaz: on it, prepping kernel test harness (small script) and will run int4 vs int8 kernel diffs overnight.
Alex Kim: thanks everyone.
